== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Stormrock is a massive floating city constructed from dark, obsidian-like [[stone]] and built upon a large green cloudbank. Resembling a jagged [[fortress]] in the sky, the city features sharp-peaked buildings and is anchored by a central, dominant tower known as [[Starsweep Tower]]. This tower serves as the headquarters for the [[Skysworn]], an organization that includes both full members and trainees. The city is a self-sustaining environment capable of housing nearly two million people, including merchants, farmers, and various families such as the [[Redflowers]]. To maintain its flight, the city requires a significant amount of [[wind]] [[scales]] and relies on many [[Underlord|Underlords]] who specialize in cloud and [[wind]] [[Paths]]. The streets of Stormrock are diverse, hosting various individuals and creatures utilizing different [[Paths]]. Due to its robust construction and protective [[scripts]], the city is designed to withstand extreme conditions, including the presence of a [[Dreadgod]]. It can also undergo rapid acceleration, which causes significant physical shaking throughout the structure.}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Stormrock serves as the [[cloudship]] city for the [[Skysworn]], maintaining a population of nearly two million people when necessary. The city houses approximately five thousand [[Skysworn]] or trainees and maintains detailed records of [[cloudship]] departures. During its travels, the city is set to pass over [[Serpent's Grave]]. Following the recent departure of [[Naru Cassias Arelius|Cassias]], Stormrock continued rushing away even after the [[Dreadgod]]'s scream had quieted.}}
